ops.reason: neck: second ring between nape and mid-neck so the head nods without collapsing
shoulder: ring half way down the upper arm so the leg swings off the chest cleanly
elbow: second ring just below the elbow ring for the bend
hip: ring half way down the thigh so the hind leg swings without tearing the flank
stifle: second ring just below the knee for the bend
eye socket: a loop inside the brow-cheek face; the eye piece sits in it
